name: video-library-classifier
description: Classifies video libraries combining ffprobe metadata + local multimodal classification with Google EmbeddingGemma 2 (Vision + Audio + Text in a unified vector space, with optional LLM auto-triage). Includes Video Moment Finder (/buscar-momento) for natural language sub-clip search, audio conversion to AIFF, and FCPXML 1.13 generation with frame-accurate sub-clip Keyword Collections across 6+ dimensions.
